reasons: Quantity matches: Datadog postgresql.rows_fetched corresponds to pg_stat_database tup_fetched, and rate() of the monotonic sum gives the per-second value the widget title describes.

Series grain differs: the OTel tup_fetched series are per database and per table (postgresql_database_name, postgresql_table_name), while the Datadog series are per monitored instance/host. avg() over all table-level series averages per table, not per host, so the value differs.

Aggregation is not equivalent: a Datadog avg over host series should be a sum per host (over tables/databases) followed by an average across hosts; the candidate averages directly over table series. A correct translation needs sum by (host_name) before averaging, or at least a documented series-grain caveat in notes.

Outcome is translated, which is acceptable for this request since the metric exists in the dataset and no function is used; the template variable $scope has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct.
